text:
alice: hey team, new here — quick q about developer API keys. I signed up and can see the console but can't find a hosted API key. is there a separate sandbox key? what are the default quotas/rate-limits I should watch for?

devex-sam: welcome, alice :wave: you should have a sandbox key automatically in the Console -> API Keys section. click "Manage keys" -> "Sandbox". if you only see a placeholder, open the dropdown and click "Create sandbox key".

alice: i do see a "sandbox (placeholder)" entry but no key value — only a rotate button. does that mean it's disabled?

devex-sam: if it's a placeholder that means you haven't generated it yet. click rotate to reveal the key once. copy it immediately — we only show it once in the UI.

onboarding-bot: Welcome to Redwood! For step-by-step setup see https://docs.redwood.ai/console/getting-started (links in #welcome-guide). If you need permissions changed, ping @devex.

liam: quick tip: for local dev we recommend saving the key to an env var. e.g.
```
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-sandbox_XXXX
# curl example
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

maya: fyi sandbox quota is soft-limited. default for new accounts is 100k tokens/day and a 60 requests/minute rate cap on hosted sandbox keys. bursts above that will get 429s. if you need more for testing, file a quick quota request (link in console) or mention approximate token needs here.

alice: thanks — is there a self-serve place for raising the quota? or is that a sales/engops thing?

liam: self-serve form in Console -> Support -> Quota Requests. pick "Sandbox / Developer" and include your team + expected daily tokens. the ops team usually approves small increases within a day.

jess (security): small security reminder: do not commit sandbox or hosted keys to public repos. rotate if you accidentally push. we recommend using a secrets manager for CI. :lock:

alice: got it. one last thing — how do i check current token usage?

maya: Console -> Usage -> Token dashboard shows last 30 days and per-key breakdown. you can also call the usage API if you want automation.

devex-sam: if anything blocks you, DM me or drop a note here with the exact error/snippet. welcome aboard! :sparkles:
